tagline.en: Flexible day-pass eSIMs with pay-as-you-go daily plans
tagline.zh: 灵活的日包eSIM，支持按天自定义的出行方案

description.en: RedteaGO is the consumer eSIM brand of Redtea Mobile, covering 180+ countries and regions. Its signature Unlimited Packages let you pick anywhere from 1 to 180 days, refreshing a daily high-speed allowance (300 MB basic / 10 GB premium) with unlimited throttled usage afterwards, alongside classic 1–50 GB data-only bundles valid up to 15 days.
description.zh: RedteaGO 是红茶移动（Redtea Mobile）旗下消费者eSIM品牌，覆盖180+国家和地区。招牌不限量套餐可自选1–180天，每天刷新高速流量（基础版300 MB/日，尊享版10 GB/日），用尽后降速不限量；同时提供1–50 GB经典数据套餐，有效期最长15天。

en: Daily high-speed data refreshes every 24 hours
Classic 1–50 GB bundles up to 15 days
zh: 高速流量每24小时自动刷新
经典数据套餐1–50 GB、最长15天
